the vendor's own pricing change post fixes the exchange rate: "1k credits ~= $1", quoted, so 3,000 free credits is about USD 3 of generation

notes: Sources disagree on whether the 3,000 credits are monthly or one-time: one review says monthly, two say one-time, and the vendor page does not render the free card at all. The credit-to-dollar rate is the vendor's, which makes this the only app builder that publishes its exchange rate.
